# CSEEL — Center for Scientific Exploration and Experiential Learning

> India's premier experiential STEM learning platform, hands-on science experiments repository, virtual lab simulations, Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL) solutions, and NEP 2020 composite science education network.

CSEEL (Center for Scientific Exploration and Experiential Learning) transforms rote textbook education into inquiry-driven discovery for Indian schools (CBSE, ICSE, and State Boards). It serves K-12 students, STEM educators, school principals, and academic institutions across India.

## Key Capabilities & Offerings

- **Virtual Laboratory Simulations**: Browser-based interactive physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics simulations with zero consumables, no breakage, and instant measurement capture.
- **NEP 2020 Experiential Learning**: Mapped directly to Kolb's Experiential Learning Cycle and the 5E Instructional Model (Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate).
- **Composite School Science Labs**: Turnkey composite science and ATL Tinkering lab equipment, safety gear, experiments kits, and teacher masterclasses.
- **EduNetwork**: Educator directory, school profiles, teacher workshops, and national STEM conclaves.

## Core Educational Domains

- **Science & Mathematics**: [https://www.cseel.org/domain/science](https://www.cseel.org/domain/science)
  - Physics: Titration, Ohm's Law, Simple Pendulum, Optics, Electromagnetic Induction.
  - Chemistry: Acid-Base Titration, Salt Analysis, Organic Chemistry, Crystal Growth.
  - Biology: Cell Structure, Photosynthesis, Genetics, Human Physiology.
  - Mathematics: Quadratic Equations, Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometric Transformations.
- **Engineering & Technology**: [https://www.cseel.org/domain/engineering](https://www.cseel.org/domain/engineering)
  - Robotics, Microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi), IoT Sensors, Bridge Load Testing, and AI Fundamentals.
  - Mapped to NITI Aayog's Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) curriculum.
- **Art & Design (STEAM)**: [https://www.cseel.org/domain/art](https://www.cseel.org/domain/art)
  - Color Physics, Photochemistry, Design Thinking, and STEAM Projects.
